subject: general
question: Tankeswar Hazarika Borbayan received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for the year 2018 for his contribution to which classical dance of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tankeswar Hazarika Borbayan is associated with Sattriya dance.
 
• Tankeswar has been selected for Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards (Akademi Puraskar) for the year 2018.
 
• Sattriya is a classical dance of India.
